messages.subject: Re: Scale_brewer question
parts:
See colorbrewer2.org. There are no palettes with more than 12 colors.
Probably because it is hard to find a set that can distinguish
between that many.

You may want to consider using something else in conjunction with
color to help distinguish that many different categories.
